phases.blurb: Before money, master the machine that acquires all knowledge: how you learn, read, take notes, think, and communicate.

nodes.title: Meta Learning
nodes.description: Meta Learning is a core concept within Learning Science. Before money, master the machine that acquires all knowledge: how you learn, read, take notes, think, and communicate.
nodes.purpose: Develop working fluency in Meta Learning so you can use it in real decisions about how to learn, think, and reason.
nodes.whyItMatters: Mastering Meta Learning strengthens your grasp of how to learn, think, and reason, a building block on the path from beginner to capital allocator.
outcomes: Explain Meta Learning clearly to a beginner.
Apply Meta Learning to a concrete, real-world money decision.
Connect Meta Learning to the broader theme of how to learn, think, and reason.
Identify common mistakes and misconceptions around Meta Learning.
exercises: Write a one-page summary of Meta Learning in your own words.
Find two real examples of Meta Learning in the news or markets.
Create a flashcard set capturing the core ideas of Meta Learning.

assignments.title: Meta Learning: Applied Worksheet
assignments.detail: Complete a structured worksheet applying Meta Learning to your personal finances.

assignments.title: Meta Learning: Teach-Back
assignments.detail: Record a 3-minute explanation of Meta Learning as if teaching a class.

assessment.q: Which statement best captures the core idea of Meta Learning?
options: It is mainly about meta learning and its practical use in decisions.
It is an obscure rule with no real application.
It only applies to large institutions.
It was disproven and is no longer used.

assessment.q: What is the best way to truly master Meta Learning?
options: Memorise the definition only.
Read about it once and move on.
Learn it, apply it to a real situation, then teach it.
Avoid using it until you are an expert.

reflection: Where have you already encountered Meta Learning in your own life or work?
What is the single most important idea within Meta Learning, and why?
How would you explain Meta Learning to a 12-year-old?
What decision will you make differently now that you understand Meta Learning?
realLife: Use Meta Learning the next time you face a decision involving how to learn, think, and reason.
Audit a past decision through the lens of Meta Learning.
Teach Meta Learning to one other person this week to cement it.

podcasts.title: Podcast episodes on how to learn, think, and reason

mastery: Beginner — Can define Meta Learning and recognise it.
Intermediate — Can apply Meta Learning to guided problems.
Advanced — Can apply Meta Learning to novel, messy situations independently.
Expert — Can critique, adapt and combine Meta Learning with other models.
Master — Can teach Meta Learning and use it fluently inside a capital-allocation framework.

nodes.whyItMatters: Mastering Risk Management strengthens your grasp of the plumbing of money, a building block on the path from beginner to capital allocator.
outcomes: Explain Risk Management clearly to a beginner.
Apply Risk Management to a concrete, real-world money decision.
Connect Risk Management to the broader theme of the plumbing of money.
Identify common mistakes and misconceptions around Risk Management.
exercises: Write a one-page summary of Risk Management in your own words.
Find two real examples of Risk Management in the news or markets.
Create a flashcard set capturing the core ideas of Risk Management.

assignments.title: Risk Management: Applied Worksheet
assignments.detail: Complete a structured worksheet applying Risk Management to your personal finances.

assignments.title: Risk Management: Teach-Back
assignments.detail: Record a 3-minute explanation of Risk Management as if teaching a class.

assessment.q: Which statement best captures the core idea of Risk Management?
options: It is mainly about risk management and its practical use in decisions.
It is an obscure rule with no real application.
It only applies to large institutions.
It was disproven and is no longer used.

assessment.q: What is the best way to truly master Risk Management?
options: Memorise the definition only.
Read about it once and move on.
Learn it, apply it to a real situation, then teach it.
Avoid using it until you are an expert.

reflection: Where have you already encountered Risk Management in your own life or work?
What is the single most important idea within Risk Management, and why?
How would you explain Risk Management to a 12-year-old?
What decision will you make differently now that you understand Risk Management?
realLife: Use Risk Management the next time you face a decision involving the plumbing of money.
Audit a past decision through the lens of Risk Management.
Teach Risk Management to one other person this week to cement it.

nodes.purpose: Develop working fluency in Security Analysis so you can use it in real decisions about compounding capital intelligently.
nodes.whyItMatters: Mastering Security Analysis strengthens your grasp of compounding capital intelligently, a building block on the path from beginner to capital allocator.
outcomes: Explain Security Analysis clearly to a beginner.
Apply Security Analysis to a concrete, real-world money decision.
Connect Security Analysis to the broader theme of compounding capital intelligently.
Identify common mistakes and misconceptions around Security Analysis.
exercises: Write a one-page summary of Security Analysis in your own words.
Find two real examples of Security Analysis in the news or markets.
Create a flashcard set capturing the core ideas of Security Analysis.

assignments.title: Security Analysis: Applied Worksheet
assignments.detail: Complete a structured worksheet applying Security Analysis to your personal finances.

assignments.title: Security Analysis: Teach-Back
assignments.detail: Record a 3-minute explanation of Security Analysis as if teaching a class.

assessment.q: Which statement best captures the core idea of Security Analysis?
options: It is mainly about security analysis and its practical use in decisions.
It is an obscure rule with no real application.
It only applies to large institutions.
It was disproven and is no longer used.

assessment.q: What is the best way to truly master Security Analysis?
options: Memorise the definition only.
Read about it once and move on.
Learn it, apply it to a real situation, then teach it.
Avoid using it until you are an expert.

reflection: Where have you already encountered Security Analysis in your own life or work?
What is the single most important idea within Security Analysis, and why?
How would you explain Security Analysis to a 12-year-old?
What decision will you make differently now that you understand Security Analysis?
realLife: Use Security Analysis the next time you face a decision involving compounding capital intelligently.
Audit a past decision through the lens of Security Analysis.
Teach Security Analysis to one other person this week to cement it.

podcasts.title: Podcast episodes on compounding capital intelligently

mastery: Beginner — Can define Security Analysis and recognise it.
Intermediate — Can apply Security Analysis to guided problems.
Advanced — Can apply Security Analysis to novel, messy situations independently.
Expert — Can critique, adapt and combine Security Analysis with other models.
Master — Can teach Security Analysis and use it fluently inside a capital-allocation framework.

careers.name: Economist
careers.description: Studies how economies allocate resources, advising governments, banks and firms using data and theory.
careers.aiImpact: Augmented — AI accelerates data work but judgement on policy and causality remains human.
careers.future: Demand rising for economists fluent in data science, climate and AI-driven productivity analysis.

careers.name: Investment Banker
careers.description: Advises companies on raising capital, M&A and restructuring; builds models and executes deals.
careers.aiImpact: Augmented — modelling is increasingly automated; relationships and judgement dominate.
careers.future: Fewer juniors doing grunt work; premium on deal judgement and sector expertise.

careers.name: Chartered Accountant (CA)
careers.description: Expert in accounting, audit, taxation and assurance — the trusted scorekeeper of business.
careers.aiImpact: Augmented — routine bookkeeping automates; advisory and assurance judgement grows in value.
careers.future: Shift from compliance to strategic advisory, ESG and forensic work.

careers.name: CFA / Research Analyst
careers.description: Analyses securities and builds investment theses across asset classes.
careers.aiImpact: Augmented — screening and summarisation automate; differentiated insight stays scarce.
careers.future: Analysts who pair domain depth with AI tooling will out-produce peers many-fold.

careers.name: Investor
careers.description: Allocates capital to compounding assets with a margin of safety and a long horizon.
careers.salary: Uncapped — function of capital, returns and discipline
careers.aiImpact: Augmented — tools sharpen research; psychology and judgement remain the edge.
careers.future: Information edges shrink; behavioural and structural edges endure.

careers.name: Portfolio Manager
careers.description: Constructs and manages portfolios to meet return and risk objectives.
careers.aiImpact: Augmented — quant overlays standard; mandate design and client trust are human.
careers.future: Blended discretionary + systematic strategies become the norm.

careers.name: Quant
careers.description: Designs mathematical and ML models to find and trade systematic edges.
careers.aiImpact: Core beneficiary — but alpha decays fast; research speed is everything.
careers.future: Alternative data + ML arms race; engineering rigour is the moat.

careers.name: Entrepreneur
careers.description: Builds products and companies that create and capture value.
careers.salary: Bimodal — many fail, winners create generational wealth
careers.aiImpact: Massive tailwind — AI collapses the cost of building and reaching customers.
careers.future: Tiny, AI-leveraged teams build category-defining products.

careers.name: Venture Capitalist
careers.description: Invests early in high-growth startups, betting on outliers and power laws.
careers.aiImpact: Augmented — sourcing and diligence speed up; pattern judgement is the craft.
careers.future: AI-native startups dominate dealflow; speed and access matter most.

careers.name: Private Equity
careers.description: Acquires, improves and exits private companies, often using leverage.
careers.aiImpact: Augmented — value creation increasingly via tech & AI transformation of portfolio cos.
careers.future: Operational alpha and AI-led efficiency become the differentiators.

careers.name: FinTech Founder
careers.description: Builds technology companies that reinvent payments, lending, investing or banking.
careers.aiImpact: Core enabler — AI underwriting, support and personalisation reshape financial products.
careers.future: Embedded finance + AI agents transacting on users' behalf.

news.title: Central banks signal a slower path on rate cuts
news.what: Major central banks indicated they will cut policy rates more gradually than markets expected, citing sticky services inflation.
news.why: Inflation in services and wages has proven stubborn even as goods inflation cooled, so policymakers are wary of easing too fast.
news.matters: Rate expectations are the gravity of asset prices. A 'higher-for-longer' stance compresses valuations for long-duration assets like growth stocks and bonds.
news.wealth: Favours cash-flow-rich, lower-duration assets; rewards patience and dry powder. Revisit discount-rate assumptions in any DCF you build.

news.title: AI agents move from demos to deployed enterprise workflows
news.what: Large firms began putting autonomous AI agents into production for finance, support and research tasks at scale.
news.why: Model reliability, tooling and cost-per-task crossed the threshold where ROI is clear for narrow, well-defined workflows.
news.matters: This compresses the cost of knowledge work and reprices the value of routine analysis versus judgement and taste.
news.wealth: Skill-stack toward judgement, distribution and capital allocation — the parts AI augments rather than replaces. Build with AI early.

news.title: India remains among the fastest-growing major economies
news.what: India's growth continued to outpace most large economies, driven by domestic demand, capex and digital infrastructure.
news.why: Favourable demographics, public investment and a maturing digital-payments stack supported broad-based activity.
news.matters: Sustained nominal growth expands corporate earnings pools and the runway for domestic compounding.
news.wealth: A long structural tailwind for patient equity investors with a domestic tilt; mind valuations, not just the narrative.

news.title: Supply chains keep diversifying away from single-country dependence
news.what: Manufacturers continued 'China+1' strategies, spreading production across India, Southeast Asia and Mexico.
news.why: Tariff risk, pandemic-era lessons and geopolitical tension pushed firms to prioritise resilience over pure cost.
news.matters: Capital is reallocating across borders, creating winners in newly favoured manufacturing hubs.
news.wealth: Watch beneficiaries in logistics, industrials and infrastructure of 'connector' economies; trade resilience is a multi-decade theme.

news.title: Startups pivot from growth-at-all-costs to durable unit economics
news.what: Venture-backed companies emphasised path-to-profitability and capital efficiency over headline growth.
news.why: Higher capital costs and a tougher funding market made cash discipline a survival requirement.
news.matters: It marks a regime change in how growth is valued — quality of growth now beats quantity.
news.wealth: Reinforces a first-principles lesson: cash flow and unit economics are what ultimately create value.

news.title: Gold holds near record highs as a portfolio hedge
news.what: Gold stayed elevated as investors and central banks added to reserves.
news.why: Currency-debasement concerns, geopolitical risk and diversification demand supported the metal.
news.matters: It highlights gold's enduring role as a non-correlated store of value in turbulent regimes.
news.wealth: A reminder to think in terms of asset-class diversification and convexity, not single-asset bets.
